observations: Photo 0 shows a silver front-loading washing machine standing in a corner on a tiled floor, plugged in.

Photo 0 top left reads 'LG' and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg'; a red sticker on the front reads 'Washer+Dryer 2in1'; a sticker on the right of the door reads 'Inverter Direct Drive 10 year warranty' (motor badge).
The programme dial ring is lit orange and the digital display shows digits, so the machine has power and the control panel lights up.
Clothes are visible inside the drum behind the door glass.
The front panel and door rim show scuffs and peeling around the red sticker; the base plinth is dented and dirty.
No rating plate or model code is visible; the back, the drum, the door seal and the inside are not shown.
No error code is readable on the display at this angle.

identity.model: Inverter Direct Drive 6/3kg Washer+Dryer 2in1 (model code not shown)
read_from: photo 0 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg' print on the panel

claims.evidence: Photo 0 'LG' logo and 'DirectDrive 6/3kg' on the panel; it is a washer dryer combo.

claims.claim: Scrap, doesn't work and needs repair

risks.risk: The fault may be the drum bearings, the direct drive motor or the main control board, leaving only scrap and parts value.
risks.proof: A clip of the machine starting a programme, showing the error code on the display and whether the drum turns.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, scrap and parts value

risks.risk: Parts may be missing or damaged inside: motor, control board, pump or heater.
risks.proof: A photo of the back with the rear panel off, showing the motor and drum in place.
risks.if_unproven: as a shell with missing parts

risks.risk: Door glass, door seal or door lock may be cracked or torn.
risks.proof: A close photo of the open door, seal and lock.
A photo of the rating plate inside the door rim or on the back.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic LG 6kg washer dryer for parts

proof_requests: A clip of the machine starting a wash programme, showing the error code and whether the drum turns.
A photo of the rating plate showing the model code.
A photo of the open door, seal and drum.
A photo of the back with the panel off, showing the motor in place, with a handwritten note carrying today's date.
response.reason: Brand and range are read off the panel in photo 0 and the seller says it does not work, so it is priced at its worst case as a non-working LG washer dryer for scrap or repair. A clip of the fault code and the motor in place would show what a repair needs.
